---
name: Chapter review
about: File a focused, structured review for a chapter (post-PR or standalone).
title: "Chapter review: chapters/NN-title.md"
labels: review
---

Please reference the chapter file and any PR or link at the top:
- Chapter file: chapters/NN-title.md
- PR or link: [paste URL]

Definition of Done (all six items, in order, for every chapter)
1. Header complete: Title, ChapterNumber, TargetWords, ContinuityNotes and FocalCharacter are all filled in, and the file is named chapters/NN-title.md.
2. The chapter number and the beat it covers match outline.md's chapter mapping; any divergence from that slot is stated in ContinuityNotes.
3. The chapter is 2,000-3,000 words of finished prose; a word count outside that range is stated and justified in ContinuityNotes.
4. Past tense and close third-person limited on a single focal character, per STYLE.md, unless the departure is flagged in ContinuityNotes.
5. Every cast name is spelled exactly as in STYLE.md (Mara Voss, Dez Okafor, Lena Voss, Colm Reyes, Thomas Ridge).
6. Any new person, boat or place named in the chapter is also named in ContinuityNotes, so the cast and setting files can be updated in step.

Audit (tick what the chapter meets, and name the number of anything it fails):
- [ ] 1 Header complete and filename correct
- [ ] 2 Number and outline.md slot match
- [ ] 3 Word count in range (or justified)
- [ ] 4 Tense, POV and distance per STYLE.md (or flagged)
- [ ] 5 Cast names spelled as in STYLE.md
- [ ] 6 New names carried into ContinuityNotes

Required fixes (must be addressed before merge — each must cite a numbered item above):
- [ ] Item #__ : describe the required change with exact line references or quoted excerpts

Suggestions (optional improvements — craft notes such as pacing, clarity, transitions and motivation live here, and do not block a merge):
- [ ] List suggestions with line references or examples

Recommended labels (apply as appropriate):
- review/major — blocking structural or continuity problems
- review/minor — copyedits, small fixes
- continuity — issues affecting the outline or arc
- copyedit — grammar, spelling, phrasing

Notes for reviewers:
- Keep reviews short and specific. Use the Required fixes area for blockers and Suggestions for optional polish.
- The six items are a floor, not a verdict on quality: a chapter can meet all six and still be voted down, but the reason should be said plainly.
- If the issue is being used as a checklist for a PR, link the PR and note whether the fixes were pushed to the branch.

Thank you for reviewing this chapter.
